messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hey, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. I need to book my physical with Dr. Patel next Friday, morning if you can.
AGENT (LATEST): I'll verify your identity first, then find you a morning slot with Dr. Patel next Friday. Great, you're all set. Next Friday would be October 3rd—is that the date you mean?  [system actions: verify_identity]

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent asks which Friday he means, or offers both Friday dates
move_1: the agent proposes, reads back or books a time on Friday, September 25 (tomorrow)
move_2: the agent offers morning times on October 2
move_3: the agent asks him to confirm Friday, October 2 (e.g. 'Friday, October 2nd, correct?')
asked_1: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "By 'next Friday' he means Friday, October 2, not tomorrow (Friday, September 25)"
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Wants the earliest morning time that day"
asked_3: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Phone 555-0177"
stop_0: Agent confirms a morning physical on Friday, October 2.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent proposed one date (Oct 3), didn't offer both Fridays."}, "move_1": {"met": false, "why": "No booking or time proposed for Sept 25."}, "move_2": {"met": false, "why": "Agent mentioned Oct 3, not offering times on Oct 2."}, "move_3": {"met": false, "why": "Agent asked about Oct 3, not Oct 2."}, "asked_1": {"met": false, "why": "Agent's question about Oct 3 doesn't match the Oct 2 fact."}, "asked_2": {"met": false, "why": "No question about earliest morning time asked."}, "asked_3": {"met": false, "why": "No question about phone number asked."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No confirmation of Oct 2 morning physical."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
